slots.label: S01 promise
slots.brief: Medium, locked camera, eye level. Caretaker turns the old lamp on; it flickers out. Sound: Switch click, electrical sputter, room wind.

slots.label: S02 clue
slots.brief: Insert, same side of desk axis. Her hand opens a shallow tray, exposing one brass fuse. Sound: Wooden tray scrape.

slots.label: S03 decision
slots.brief: Medium close, same screen direction. She picks up the fuse and examines its intact filament. Sound: Coat fabric, wind.

slots.label: S04 action
slots.brief: Close on hands and opened lamp base. She seats the fuse in the socket. Sound: Metal contact click.

slots.label: S05 payoff
slots.brief: Return to opening setup. She turns the lamp on; warm steady light fills the desk. Sound: Switch click, quiet hum.

slots.label: S06 meaning
slots.brief: Wider view through the window. She sits beside the light while a distant boat passes in the dark. Sound: Distant boat engine, wind softens.
